text:
emily: heads-up: weve observed churn where long-running streaming requests flip between v1 and v2 mid-session. users report truncated streams.
raj: wow. streaming churn? likely debounce logic in routing that re-evaluates header+cache mid-stream.
deploy-bot: rollout: stream-routing-debounce fix -> canary deployed to edge cluster eu-west at 2026-04-02T01:12Z.
liz: timeline: routing checks every 30s for affinity rebinds; if header switches or cache invalidates, we re-resolve route and can attach a new model instance for next chunk. that's probably the cause.
tom: confirm: streaming protocol uses chunk-level route resolution today. we should pin route for the session once first chunk is accepted. header should still be honored on session start only.
emily: customers affected are enterprise tenants behind managed gateways that sometimes strip or re-insert headers during retries. intermittent header presence -> oscillation.
raj: telemetry ask: add a per-session `route_changes` counter and a `stream_truncation` boolean tag. also a histogram of time_to_first_chunk and time_between-changes.
liz: console UX: add "session stability" column on active sessions page showing route_changes and last_change_ts; add ability to forcibly pin session to current route for 15m (staff only).
tom: quota note: pinning a streaming session to v2 may alter token accounting and concurrency. show preflight: est token delta and concurrency slot delta in modal.
emily: quick SQL used for detection:
```sql
SELECT session_id, tenant, count(DISTINCT route) routes, sum(tokens) tokens
FROM stream_chunks_48h
GROUP BY session_id, tenant
HAVING count(DISTINCT route) > 1
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
raj: sampling: we under-sampled problematic sessions. propose a sampling rule: any session with >1 route changes -> sample 100% for 24h and attach full traces.
liz: UX question: should we expose a per-tenant knob: "session-route-lock window" default 15m? product might want 1m by default in low-latency cases.
tom: prefer a safe default 15m and per-tenant override via console (staff only) with audit entries.
emily: fallback plan: if we flip to session-pin and see token burn >25% on canary tenants, auto-revert to chunk-level resolution.
raj: canary plan: enable session-pin for 10% tenants in eu-west for 2h then expand. watch metrics: stream_error_rate, avg_route_changes, token_burn_delta.
emily: action items:
- raj: add route_changes metric + sampling rule for multi-route sessions
- liz: console: add session stability column and staff-only pin modal with preflight estimates
- tom: implement session-pin server-side with 15m TTL and rollback hooks
- emily: notify SEs for tenants were sampling and collect examples

emily: thanks all. leaving traces and examples here as we collect them. :mag_right:
